title: 149-0: the match where every goal was an own goal

voice._name: Callum (ElevenLabs premade), eleven_v3 with audio tags in "say"; the settings of plea2005 (STYLE_BIBLE rule 68)

post:
Madagascar, 31 October 2002. AS Adema 149, SO l'Emyrne 0, and every single goal was an own goal: a protest against the referees that is still a world record.

#football #soccer #footballhistory #madagascar #worldrecord #owngoal #footballtiktok

phrases.text: 149–0. The craziest scoreline in football. And every goal was an own goal.
phrases.say: [intrigued] One hundred and forty-nine to nil. ... The craziest scoreline in football. ... And every goal... was an own goal.

phrases.text: Stade Olympique de l'Emyrne were the defending champions. But in their previous match, a late, disputed penalty handed the title to AS Adema.
phrases.say: Stade Olympique de l'Emyrne were the defending champions. But in their previous match... a late, disputed penalty handed the title to AS Adema.

phrases.text: So for the last game, against Adema, their coach planned a protest: every time his players got the ball, they would score into their own net.
phrases.say: [mischievously] So for the last game, against Adema... their coach planned a protest. Every time his players got the ball... they would score into their own net.

phrases.text: Kick-off. They turn, and shoot into their own goal. Again. And again. One goal every 36 seconds.
phrases.say: [tense] Kick-off. ... They turn... and shoot into their own goal. ... Again. ... And again. ... One goal every thirty-six seconds.

phrases.text: AS Adema's players just stood and watched, as the score kept climbing. 50. 100. 149.
phrases.say: [amused] AS Adema's players just stood and watched... as the score kept climbing. Fifty. ... A hundred. ... One hundred and forty-nine.

phrases.text: In the stands, fans went to the ticket booths and asked for their money back.
phrases.say: In the stands... fans went to the ticket booths, and asked for their money back.

phrases.text: The federation banned the coach for three years and suspended several players. And 149 own goals is still a world record.
phrases.say: [firmly] The federation banned the coach for three years... and suspended several players. ... [quietly] And one hundred and forty-nine own goals... is still a world record.
